content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a service that allows you to host static websites directly from a GitHub repository. This means you can create an online store for your digital products without incurring hosting costs. The significance lies in its ability to empower creators who are often sidelined by conventional payment platforms. By using GitHub Pages, creators can maintain complete control over their sales process, sidestepping the high fees charged by services like Gumroad, which takes 10% on each sale. This is critical for maximizing profits and ensuring that your hard work pays off.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages digital product store is straightforward yet effective. It involves using a GitHub repository to store your website files, which are then served directly to visitors. You can enhance functionality using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, facilitating automated processes such as order fulfillment. Additionally, integrating NOWPayments allows for seamless crypto payment processing, charging only a 0.5% fee. This combination creates a robust infrastructure that works independently of traditional payment processors, making it ideal for creators in restrictive regions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are either unavailable or inefficient. If you're selling ebooks, templates, or courses and facing payment barriers, GitHub Pages provides a pathway to establish a fully operational online store without the constraints imposed by platforms like PayPal or Stripe. This architecture caters specifically to those who need a reliable, low-cost solution to host and sell their digital products directly to customers globally.
Maximize your profits by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for handling backend processes, and NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. Each piece plays a crucial role in the overall functionality of your digital store. By utilizing these tools, you ensure that your customers receive instant access to their purchases without any manual intervention. This automation not only saves time but also enhances the user experience, allowing you to focus more on product creation and less on logistics.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your GitHub Pages digital product store, start by setting up a GitHub account and creating a new repository. Upload your website files, including product information and sales pages. Next, configure Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing and delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. For a comprehensive guide and templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints for building and scaling your digital commerce stack effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages to host your store, combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to bypass traditional payment barriers and retain more profit since NOWPayments charges only 0.5% compared to the 10% fees from platforms like Gumroad.
Automate product delivery for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a valuable resource that includes everything you need for a sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started on your independent selling journey.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a GitHub Pages store?

To set up a GitHub Pages store, create a GitHub account, then create a new repository. Upload your HTML files and configure the repository settings to enable GitHub Pages. This will make your site live and accessible to customers.
What types of products can I sell?

You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The flexibility of GitHub Pages allows you to tailor your offerings to fit your audience.
How do I automate product delivery?

Automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage orders. Once a payment is confirmed through NOWPayments, the script can automatically send the product link to the buyer, ensuring a seamless transaction.
Why choose NOWPayments over traditional processors?

NOWPayments offers lower fees, only 0.5%, compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This means you retain more of your earnings, an important consideration for independent creators aiming to maximize profits.
Can I scale my business using this model?

Absolutely. This model is designed for scalability. As your sales grow, you can easily add more products and enhance your backend systems without incurring significant costs, allowing you to expand your digital offerings efficiently.
